RM27.implication: the temporal endpoint difference is detectable in the next-window fixed-interface response, so exact functional identity cannot be claimed

contract_conclusions: The inherited F-GC44 1e-5 cm global head budget remains unauthorized for active irrigation.

A global maximum profile-head requirement is not an appropriate sole temporal metric for the current coupling purpose because RM26 localizes the discrepancy at the surface while conserving total storage and external transfers.
Exact q_swap(H) identity at the F-GC44 nonlinear residual resolution is also too strong to use automatically as an application temporal requirement; RM27 detects a real but small response offset.
RM28 quantifies the resulting coupled effect but does not provide independent authority to call it acceptable.
No additional numerical characterization can by itself close the production-admission gap without an independent intended-application temporal-fidelity requirement.
